msg: There are two different groupings for the gnomes. Group A is blue, red, pink and purple. Group B is brown, yellow, orange and green. One of the groups will always give you more points than the other, but I was not able to find out how often they rotate. At first, it felt like every 2-3 turns, but towards the end, they were lasting much longer. You'll be able to tell when it swaps because 5x multipliers will give you anywhere from 30-40 if you select the correct gnome. If 1x multipliers are lower than 5, choose the opposite gnome. If the 5x multiplier is lower than 25, choose the opposite gnome. Good luck!
